research_priority.primary: predict the next closing spread and total and identify opener prices likely to beat that close
research_priority.secondary: measure whether the same temporary adjustment improves next-game score prediction

definitions.raw_postgame_delta: predicted next-game market innovation from the completed game
definitions.expected_market_close: market baseline plus calibrated raw postgame delta
definitions.saturday_shadow_line: official model plus a separately validated temporary adjustment

total.one_prior_policy: baseline retained until a separately validated model beats zero-change baseline

official_blend_history_audit.status: historical official blend snapshots not found

when_official_history_exists: join each pregame official projection to the same game's closing line
attach the prior completed game's raw postgame delta for each team
test official + lambda*delta against the next closing line
select lambda on 2024 validation and report untouched 2025 holdout
repeat against actual margin/total only as a secondary scorecard
next_experiment.adoption_rule: The primary Saturday adjustment is adopted only if it reduces next-closing-line MAE and improves calibration on the locked holdout.
